clue.text: Sound off right away, after one tucked into crusty roll

indicators.note: the shortened rant comes after the first part, so it is placed at the end
one thing tucked into another sits inside it, so the numeral goes within the bad-tempered word

parts.note: a crusty person is irritable, cross
the Roman numeral for one is I

indicators.note: sent away means taken out, so the abbreviation for right is removed

parts.note: to sound off is to rant

explanation.surface: Someone grumbling about a hard-baked bread roll they have just bitten into.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crusty' looks like a description of the roll but means bad-tempered. 'away' removes R from RANT, leaving ANT.
explanation.definitionFit: A croissant is a crescent-shaped flaky pastry, a kind of breakfast roll.

clue.text: Cried out for a drink

indicators.note: out suggests the letters are put out of order, rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone shouting to be served a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Cider is an alcoholic drink made from fermented apples.

clue.text: Possess dress, not grand

indicators.note: not grand says the gown goes without its abbreviation for grand

parts.note: a gown is a dress
G is short for grand, a thousand pounds

explanation.surface: Having a frock that isn't particularly fancy.
explanation.definitionFit: To own something is to have it as property, a direct synonym for possess.

clue.text: Focus attention on minor securing trophy

indicators.note: securing means holding on to, so the word for minor wraps round the trophy

parts.note: slight means minor, small
a pot is slang for a sporting trophy or cup

explanation.surface: Highlighting a youngster who has won a cup.
explanation.definitionFit: To spotlight something is to draw attention to it, as a stage lamp picks out a performer.

clue.text: Complaint of menial working on top of tower

indicators.note: working means being worked into a new form, so these letters are rearranged
the top of a down-clue word is its first letter

explanation.surface: A grumble from a lowly worker labouring high up on a tower.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Complaint' suggests a grievance, but here it is an illness.
explanation.definitionFit: A complaint in the medical sense is an illness or disorder.

clue.text: Sea god assuming tail of ray in attempt to deceive

indicators.note: assuming means taking on, so the sea god takes the letter into himself

parts.note: Triton is a Greek sea god, son of Poseidon

indicators.note: the tail of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: A sea deity wearing a fish's tail as a disguise to trick someone.
explanation.definitionFit: To try it on is an informal idiom for testing whether a bluff or cheeky deception will work.

clue.text: Crack in rig initially overlooked

indicators.note: the first letter is passed over and left out

parts.note: to rig out or equip is to fit out

explanation.surface: A fault in some equipment that was missed at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Crack' seems to be a fracture in the rig, but it is a witty remark.
explanation.definitionFit: A crack is a joke or wisecrack, which is what a quip is.

clue.text: Held in custody below, a leader of ring and others

parts.note: under means below

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter

parts.note: the rest means the others

explanation.surface: A gang boss and his crew locked up downstairs.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ring' suggests a criminal ring, but only its first letter is used.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone under arrest has been detained by police and is held in custody.

clue.text: Cheese and wine welcome when lacking energy

parts.note: port is a fortified wine

indicators.note: lacking means going without, so the energy symbol is dropped

parts.note: a salute is a greeting or welcome
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: Offering guests cheese and wine, but with little enthusiasm.
explanation.definitionFit: Port Salut is a mild, semi-soft French cheese first made by Trappist monks.

clue.text: Soldiers, last in ward, get better

parts.note: men is a crossword word for soldiers, the ranks

indicators.note: the last letter in the word is taken

explanation.surface: Wounded troops recovering in a hospital ward.
explanation.definitionFit: To mend is to heal or recover, as a broken bone mends.

clue.text: Wild dog daughter shot protecting home

indicators.note: protecting means surrounding, so daughter and attempt together go round the word for home

parts.note: a shot is a go, an attempt
in means at home

explanation.surface: A girl shooting a feral dog to defend her house.
explanation.walkthrough: 'shot' reads as gunfire but means an attempt.
explanation.definitionFit: The dingo is the wild dog of Australia.

clue.text: Head describing Scottish town preacher

indicators.note: describing in its sense of drawing round, so the head encloses the town

parts.note: a leader is a head
Ayr is a town on the west coast of Scotland

explanation.surface: A school head giving an account of a Scottish town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'describing' is used in its geometric sense of tracing a line around something.
explanation.definitionFit: A lay reader is a non-ordained person licensed to lead church services and preach.

clue.text: Call to mind first half of authentic prayer

indicators.note: the first half of the word is taken, its opening two letters

parts.note: real means authentic, genuine
a collect is a short prayer in Christian liturgy

explanation.surface: Remembering how a genuine prayer begins.
explanation.walkthrough: A collect (stressed on the first syllable) is a short set prayer for a particular day.
explanation.definitionFit: To recollect is to remember, bringing something back to memory.

clue.text: Gambling game: clubs delay introducing limit

indicators.note: introducing means coming before, so the limit word precedes the delay

parts.note: C is the card abbreviation for clubs
to hem in is to limit or confine
to defer is to delay

explanation.surface: A description of a card game played slowly at a club.
explanation.definitionFit: Chemin de fer is a casino card game, a version of baccarat.

clue.text: Sudden quick movements in game

definitions.meaning: to dart is to move swiftly and suddenly
a pub game of throwing small missiles at a board

explanation.surface: Rapid lunges during a match.
explanation.definitionFit: Darts are quick dashes, and darts is also the pub game of throwing arrows at a board.

clue.text: Be tense suppressing awful urge for pot

indicators.note: suppressing means holding down inside, so the scrambled urge goes within

parts.note: T is the grammar abbreviation for tense

indicators.note: awful suggests the letters are in a bad state, jumbled

explanation.surface: Advice to stay anxious while fighting a terrible craving for cannabis.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pot' tempts as marijuana or a cooking vessel but means a paunch.
explanation.definitionFit: A pot or potbelly is a protruding stomach, often blamed on heavy drinking.

clue.text: Scented stuff from spa lasts, if sprinkled

parts.note: Bath is an English spa city

indicators.note: sprinkled means scattered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Perfumed products from a health resort keep longer when scattered.
explanation.walkthrough: Bath is a city in Somerset, famous for its Roman spa.
explanation.definitionFit: Bath salts are perfumed crystals dissolved in bathwater.

clue.text: Wild, as is to be expected

definitions.meaning: untamed or uncultivated, in its original state
normal and unsurprising in the circumstances

explanation.definitionFit: Natural means untouched by humans, and also normal or what one would expect.

clue.text: Plane, one with brightly coloured wings

definitions.meaning: a de Havilland biplane used for flight training
a moth species with vivid orange and black markings

explanation.surface: An aircraft with gaudily painted wings.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tiger Moth is a classic 1930s training biplane, and also a boldly patterned moth.

clue.text: Dicky writes about onset of tragic tornado

indicators.note: about means around, so the rearranged letters go round the opening letter
dicky is informal for faulty, unsound, so the letters are rearranged
the onset of a word is its first letter

explanation.surface: Someone named Dicky writing about the beginning of a deadly storm.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dicky' looks like a name but is the anagram signal; WRITES rearranges to TWISER, which goes 'about' T.
explanation.definitionFit: Twister is American slang for a tornado, from its spinning column of air.

clue.text: Ivy League university raised in revolutionary broadcast

indicators.note: in puts the reversed name inside the political colour

parts.note: a red is a revolutionary, a communist

indicators.note: raised in a down clue means written upwards, reversed

parts.note: Yale is an Ivy League university in Connecticut

explanation.surface: A campus radical promoted at Yale makes a broadcast.
explanation.definitionFit: To relay a programme is to pass it on by transmission, to broadcast it.

clue.text: Part of series involving Federal agents

indicators.note: involving means containing, so the series wraps round the agents

parts.note: a set is a series or collection
G-men are FBI agents, government men

explanation.surface: An episode of a TV series featuring the FBI.
explanation.definitionFit: A segment is a portion or section of a whole.

clue.text: National topic

definitions.meaning: a citizen of a country, as in a British national

explanation.definitionFit: A subject is both a citizen owing allegiance to a state and a theme of discussion.

clue.text: Small border plant

parts.note: S is the clothing-size abbreviation for small
an edge is a border

explanation.surface: A little plant growing along a garden border.
explanation.definitionFit: Sedge is a grass-like plant that grows in wet ground.

clue.text: Presenting few difficulties in store, as yet

indicators.note: in signals that the letters are found inside the words that follow

explanation.surface: Things are straightforward at the shop, for now.
explanation.definitionFit: Easy describes a task that is simple and causes little trouble.

clue.text: Let go, student I rebuked

parts.note: L is a learner, from the L-plate on a learner driver's car
to berate is to rebuke or scold

explanation.surface: A teacher confessing to dismissing a pupil after telling them off.
explanation.definitionFit: Liberated means freed, released from captivity.

clue.text: Sketch rear of wagon pulled along

parts.note: to draw is to sketch

indicators.note: the rear of a word is its last letter

explanation.surface: Drawing the back of a cart being hauled.
explanation.definitionFit: Drawn means hauled, as a carriage drawn by horses.

clue.text: Way of living in Ely itself changed

indicators.note: changed means altered, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A cathedral city transformed in how its residents live.
explanation.walkthrough: Ely is a small cathedral city in Cambridgeshire.
explanation.definitionFit: A lifestyle is the manner in which a person lives.

clue.text: Love huge Greek character

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O
mega means huge

explanation.surface: Adoring an enormous man from Greece.
explanation.walkthrough: 'character' is a letter of the alphabet, not a person.
explanation.definitionFit: Omega is the last letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: English artist shows age

parts.note: RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A painter from England showing signs of getting old.
explanation.definitionFit: An era is a long period of history, an age.

clue.text: Angry and very rude on vacation

parts.note: so means very, as in so good

indicators.note: vacated means emptied, so only the outside letters remain

explanation.surface: Cross and extremely impolite while on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: Sore is informal, chiefly American, for annoyed or resentful.

clue.text: Farm building may make wife and child disheartened

parts.note: old Dutch is Cockney slang for wife

indicators.note: losing its heart, the central letter is removed

parts.note: a bairn is a Scottish word for a child

explanation.surface: A rural shed where a spouse and youngster might become dispirited.
explanation.walkthrough: 'my old Dutch' is Cockney for one's wife; bairn is Scots and northern English for a child.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dutch barn is an open-sided farm shed with a curved roof for storing hay.
